description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Identity Digital is hiring a Software Engineer I to build and deliver production features for its Top Level Domain Registry Platform. The role collaborates with experienced engineers to design, build, and test scalable, reliable software systems and support their performance and stability.
Entry-level software engineer developing, troubleshooting, and supporting business systems

Responsibilities:
• Develop, implement, and support technical solutions that align with business requirements throughout the software development lifecycle
• Troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and recommend improvements to enhance system performance and maintainability
• Provide on-call system support to ensure reliability and stability of business operations
• Demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous improvement and system efficiency
• Actively models and promotes Identity Digital’s core values through day-to-day interactions, behaviors, and decision-making
• Other duties as assigned

Requirements:
• 0+ years of relevant experience developing enterprise software with object-oriented programming languages like C# .NET, Java, or other major languages
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering. or combination of education and experience
• Experience writing web applications and services, background services, and class libraries
• Experience with SQL (MS-SQL / MySQL / PostgreSQL), SQL query language, NoSQL
• Proficient in troubleshooting technical problems
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to work across time zones as part of a global organization as needed

Preferred:
• Master's degree
• Experience working with cloud technologies, service-oriented architecture (SOA), service bus, and queuing technologies are strong assets
